sources.title: NPC Circular No. 2023-06, signed official circular

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

Replaces NPC Circular 16-01. Registration thresholds, sector duties and breach reporting under other issuances require separate review; undefined high-volume criteria are not replaced with invented numbers.
